0.original: Captain Doesrael, stationed at Oschon's Embrace, needs you to track down a guard who has abandoned his duties.

1.original: With the recent increase in deliveries being sent between the Moraby Drydocks and Limsa Lominsa, passage across Oschon's Embrace has slowed to a crawl. Find Wyrstmaga, the guard whose duty it is to ensure smooth travel across the bridge.

2.original: Wyrstmaga appears intimidated by the angry shouts of the drivers as they fume at the seemingly interminable delays. Do your best to /soothe the irate coachmen so that the harried guard might return to his post and perform his duties in relative peace.

3.original: You have managed to soothe the irate coachmen. Report your success to Wyrstmaga and have him return to his post.

4.original: Wyrstmaga has returned to his post on the bridge. Report your progress to Captain Doesrael at Oschon's Embrace.

5.original: The conflict preventing passage across Oschon's Embrace has been resolved. But with work on the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103> demanding ever more materials, you can only wonder how Wyrstmaga will cope with the steadily increasing traffic on the bridge.

48.original: Eh? Ye be wantin' to cross Oschon's Embrace? If ye ain't in a hurry to be some place, I'd rather ye hold off for a bell or two─presently, the bridge is such a right confusion o' wagons an' such, the damn thing's like to collapse.

49.original: We expect a <hex:021A020203>bit<hex:021A020103> o' congestion, what with this bein' the only bridge connectin' the roads from the Drydocks to Limsa Lominsa, but today's traffic is somethin' awful.

50.original: Speakin' o' which, what in the seven hells does Wyrstmaga think he's playin' at desertin' his post at a time like this? Do me a favor, would ye, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>? Track down that skittish bugger an' tell him to get his arse back to directin' the chaos at the Embrace.

51.original: Bah, 'twas only a matter o' time before they sent someone after me, I suppose. Aye, I heard ye─the bridge is a bloody mess. Truth be told, I wish the damn thing <hex:021A020203>would<hex:021A020103> collapse and save me the sufferin'.

52.original: I can't simply wave me hands an' have everythin' suddenly sort itself out, now can I? An' if I try reasonin' with those demon-spawned coachmen, I'm like to get me head bit off.

53.original: Listen, if yer not goin' to let me be, then can ye at least have a word with the more irate wagon drivers? Ye know, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>soothe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> their tempers some? That'll be one less headache for me to deal with.

54.original: Good sirs and ladies! Calm yourselves! There's no need to─oh gods...

55.original: I got me a load o' goods from the Drydocks meant for Forgemaster H'naanza herself! Now yield the way afore I drive me wagon right over yer squealin' hide!

56.original: And my cargo's already late for the shipyard! If you want to be the one to explain to the Admiral why her <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103> is behind schedule, then be my bloody guest!

57.original: Blocked again!? They'll have the road backed up all the way to the gates at this rate. I swear by the Navigator, I'll kick those wagons over the sides my damn self if this bridge doesn't open up soon!

58.original: <groan> This is the third time this week. I must have these fish across and properly stored before they begin to spoil!

59.original: Ye have a word with those irate coachmen an' <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>soothe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> some tempers, an' I'll soon have the rest of this mess sorted out.

60.original: Well, I'll be damned. Ye actually managed to calm them buggers down!? Yer a miracle worker, an' that's the honest truth.

61.original: All I need is for the drivers to heed me directions without all that snappin' an' snarlin', ye see. Well, I'd best be at it afore they lose their tempers again.

62.original: Oh, an' I'd appreciate it if ye could let Captain Doesrael know I'm back on the job.

63.original: Thank you kindly, adventurer! We should be able to get things moving again as soon as─ Hm? Now where did Wyrstmaga disappear to!?

64.original: Hmph. Ye could be right, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. Maybe there <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> room for both of us to squeeze past if I shift an ilm or two to the left. Probably could've seen that for meself if I hadn't been so busy screamin'. Heh heh.

65.original: I'm sore glad at least one person on this bridge has <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> head on straight. Perhaps those useless guards should retire and let <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> assume their post.

66.original: Well done, mate, well done! Might've been a good show if it'd come to blows, but we all have places to be, now don't we?

67.original: <sigh> Now half my Drydocks shipment is spoiled thanks to this cursed bridge and its endless delays. If only I had spent more coin on chilling the fish...

68.original: Wyrstmaga is back at his post, is he? Yer tongue must be made o' silver to have accomplished that feat!

69.original: He can't handle the yellin', you see. The gods only know how such a delicate flower survived guard trainin' in the first place.

70.original: An' he's never goin' to survive duty at the bridge now that work on the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103> has a flood o' deliveries comin' in an' out every bloody day. Wyrstmaga better harden up, or start lookin' for a quieter line o' work.

71.original: Make way, ye ugly bilge rat! I should've been in Limsa bells ago! Eh!? I'll calm down when fishbacks learn to fly! Now move yer arse!

72.original: Well, if ye put it like that, then maybe I'll hold me tongue for a bit.

73.original: You can take your self-important words and take a dive in the harbor! I have shipwrights expecting this cargo, and it'll be a cold day in Thanalan before I back down first!

74.original: Perhaps you do have a point. I shall endeavor to keep a hold on my temper, if only to see this situation resolved before the moon turns.
